LanguageData.CC_Storyline_Offered: offered, waiting for the colony's answer
LanguageData.CC_Storyline_Share: {WHO} of {FACTION} came by with the colony's share of this season's trade: {SILVER} silver.
LanguageData.CC_Storyline_Factor_Status: Crates here, sealed and dry: {HELD} of {TOTAL}.
LanguageData.CC_Storyline_Factor_Unroofed: {COUNT} of them have no roof over them.
LanguageData.CC_Storyline_Rival_Coming: {RIVAL} is on the way to the gate.
LanguageData.CC_Storyline_Rival_Asked: The trader is at the gate, waiting for the colony's answer.
LanguageData.CC_Storyline_Pay_Coming: People of {FACTION} come for the silver within {DAYS}.
LanguageData.CC_Storyline_Impact_Sell: If {GIVER} finds out who bought the crates, {GIVER} will ask the colony to pay what they were worth.
LanguageData.CC_Storyline_Impact_Refuse: {GIVER} comes for the crates later in the season and pays {FEE} silver for the keeping.
LanguageData.CC_Storyline_Impact_RefuseBrief: the factor pays for the keeping
LanguageData.CC_Storyline_Impact_Tell: {GIVER} hears that the colony refused the offer.
LanguageData.CC_Storyline_Beast_Ready: Traps built: {TRAPS} of {TRAPGOAL}. Lengths of wall or fence built: {WALLS} of {WALLGOAL}. Animals in a pen or a room: {KEPT} of {ANIMALS} ({NEEDED} needed).
LanguageData.CC_Storyline_Beast_Signs: The kill lies at the edge of the colony's land, {WAY}.
LanguageData.CC_Storyline_Children_Hungry: The children from the burned village of {FACTION} went short today: when they were hungry the stores had nothing for them, so they ate the food they brought.
LanguageData.CC_Storyline_Children_NoRoof: Not every one of the children from the burned village of {FACTION} had a bed today: each of them needs a free bed or sleeping spot under a roof.
LanguageData.CC_Storyline_Children_Neither: The children from the burned village of {FACTION} went short today: when they were hungry the stores had nothing for them, so they ate the food they brought, and not every one of them had a bed or sleeping spot under a roof.
LanguageData.CC_Storyline_Children_Coming: {COUNT} people from the burned village arrive within {DAYS}.
LanguageData.CC_Storyline_Children_Asking: The colony is asked what should become of the children.
LanguageData.CC_Storyline_Children_Fetch: People of {OTHERPEOPLE} are coming for the children.
LanguageData.CC_Storyline_Children_Going: The children are about to go on.
LanguageData.CC_Storyline_Impact_TakeIn: The {COUNT} children join the colony as colonists.
LanguageData.CC_Storyline_Impact_Place: Someone from a neighbouring people comes for the children within a day and takes them to their new home.
LanguageData.CC_Storyline_Impact_Join: {NAME} joins the colony as a colonist.
LanguageData.CC_Storyline_Back_Coming: {NAME} comes to the gate within a day.
